name: Trader Joe's Vegetable Bird's Nests (Deep-Fried Onion & Carrot Warning)
whyItWorks: Tangled birds-nest clusters of shredded yellow onions, carrots, and kale bound in tempura batter and deep-fried. The primary ingredient is fried whole onion shreds (massive allium fructans) saturated in frying oil, which creates agonizing gas colic and rapid transit.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Severe Trigger Warning: Avoid this fried onion tangle during active IBD.
watchOuts: Massive concentration of fried allium fructans and grease causes acute abdominal cramping.
